name: IT administrator
summary: Sets up and looks after a small office's devices, accounts, backups and server chores. Writes scripts that are safe to run twice.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge from Microsoft, Google, CISA, NCSC Cyber Essentials v3.3, ENISA and NIST with 29 sources; four skills (tenant security baseline, starters and leavers, backup and restore plan, safe admin scripts); six prompts; two workflows; training interview and test briefs.
